mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE(su.created_at), '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sys_user su WHERE DATE(su.created_at) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(su.created_at) ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE(su.last_login_at), '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sys_user su WHERE su.last_login_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(su.last_login_at) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(su.last_login_at) ORDER BY date

SELECT sc.id AS categoryId, sc.name AS name, COUNT(ss.id) AS count FROM scenic_category sc LEFT JOIN scenic_spot ss ON ss.category_id = sc.id AND ss.deleted = 0 GROUP BY sc.id, sc.name UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS categoryId, '未分类' AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scenic_spot ss WHERE ss.deleted = 0 AND (ss.category_id IS NULL OR ss.category_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM scenic_category)) ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE(sr.created_at), '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scenic_reservation sr WHERE DATE(sr.created_at) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(sr.created_at) ORDER BY date

SELECT ss.id AS spotId, ss.name AS name, COUNT(sr.id) AS count FROM scenic_spot ss LEFT JOIN scenic_reservation sr ON sr.spot_id = ss.id WHERE ss.deleted = 0 GROUP BY ss.id, ss.name ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT HOUR(rv.verified_at) AS hour, SUM(rv.verified_count) AS count FROM reservation_verification rv INNER JOIN scenic_reservation sr ON rv.reservation_id = sr.id WHERE sr.spot_id = #{spotId} AND rv.result = 1 AND DATE(rv.verified_at) = CURDATE() GROUP BY HOUR(rv.verified_at) ORDER BY hour
